brasil.description: Get to know the story behind Alme and discover a complete custom millwork experience designed for the Brazilian market.

heroAbout.title: Get to know us!
heroAbout.paragraph1: Every project represents a dream, an investment, and the expectation of transforming a space into something truly unique. That's why we believe custom millwork should go beyond technical execution—it should provide security, transparency, and confidence at every stage of the process.
heroAbout.paragraph2: It is with this vision that we have built our story.

secondAbout.paragraph1: Alme Custom Millwork was founded in 2020 by two childhood friends with the goal of providing a safer, more organized, and more reliable approach to custom millwork projects. From the very beginning, our commitment has been to turn challenges into well-managed processes, ensuring peace of mind for both clients and partners.
secondAbout.paragraph2: More than delivering custom millwork, we strive to build trust. We want our clients to feel supported, confident, and cared for throughout the entire journey, knowing their project is in good hands.

items.title: Contact
items.text: Every great project starts with a conversation. Our team is ready to understand your project's needs, answer your questions, and learn the details that make all the difference in the final result. During this stage, we align expectations, review the initial information, and gather everything needed to prepare your quote.

items.title: Estimate
items.text: Based on the information provided, we prepare a detailed estimate that considers materials, finishes, hardware, dimensions, and all project specifications. Our goal is to provide a clear, accurate proposal tailored to your project's requirements.

items.title: Proposal & Agreement
items.text: Once the estimate is complete, we send a comprehensive proposal outlining the project scope, pricing, lead times, and commercial terms. After the proposal is approved and signed, we officially begin production planning, ensuring every stage moves forward exactly as agreed.

items.title: Project Approval
items.text: Before manufacturing begins, we develop the shop drawings for your review and approval. During this stage, you will verify dimensions, finishes, construction details, and all project specifications. Production only begins after final approval, ensuring every detail is fully aligned.

items.title: Pre-assembly
items.text: Before shipping, we pre-assemble the cabinetry to verify fit, hardware functionality, alignment, and the quality of each component. This process allows us to identify and make any necessary adjustments, ensuring the product arrives ready for a smooth and accurate installation.

items.title: Shipping & Delivery
items.text: After the pre-assembly stage, every cabinet component is carefully labeled, protected, and packaged for transportation. Each piece is organized to simplify installation at its destination. The product is delivered pre-assembled and fully identified, allowing your installation team to complete the assembly efficiently, safely, and exactly as designed.

vem.title: Let's make things happen
vem.description: Every great project begins with the right decision. Get in touch with our team and discover what's possible.

items.title: EXCELLENCE
items.text: We pursue the highest standards in everything we do, delivering an exceptional experience and setting the benchmark at every stage of the project. From planning and technical coordination to production and final delivery, we pay close attention to every detail, ensuring precision, consistency, and uncompromising quality that exceed expectations.

items.title: COMMITMENT
items.text: We stand by our word with responsibility, transparency, and respect, turning promises into results. We build trust through clear communication, accountability, and reliable execution, fostering long-term relationships with clients, architects, partners, and everyone involved in each project.

items.title: CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
items.text: We are constantly learning, refining our processes, and embracing innovation to keep evolving. By challenging ourselves to improve every day, we enhance efficiency, strengthen collaboration, and deliver increasingly smarter, more reliable, and higher-quality solutions.

items.title: LONGEVITY
items.text: We think long-term, building lasting relationships and making sustainable decisions that stand the test of time. We value consistency, durability, and trust, creating partnerships and solutions designed to generate lasting value for both our clients and our business.

items.title: GROWTH
items.text: We believe in shared success, creating opportunities and generating value for our clients, team members, and partners. By growing together, encouraging collaboration, and investing in people and innovation, we create a stronger ecosystem where everyone has the opportunity to thrive and prosper.
